ATT&CK Incident Mapper

Paste an incident narrative. Each step is mapped to MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise, ICS or Mobile techniques, laid out on the kill chain, and compared against known threat groups.

ATT&CK data files

Drop MITRE STIX files here or
enterprise-attack.json, ics-attack.json, mobile-attack.json. The domain is detected from the file contents, so file names don’t matter.
Get new releases from github.com/mitre-attack/attack-stix-data (the files at the repository root are always the latest). Loaded files are kept in this browser. Mappings that use a technique ID MITRE has since replaced are remapped automatically.

Incident

“Map incident” runs instantly in your browser using ATT&CK phrase rules and text matching. “Map with Claude” reads the narrative as an analyst would and works best on loosely written reports.
Keep one file per engagement. Your current work is also kept in this browser.
